english_evidence: Review (An Nguyen): 'Een ideale plek voor Engelssprekenden met goede instructies!' and review (Anirudh Mittal): 'Ik heb mijn lessen in het Engels gevolgd en dat ging heel goed.'
notes: Single-instructor eenmanszaak (KvK 88886654, 1 employee per oozo.nl), founded ~2023 (clickdrive: '3 jaar ervaring'; rijloket: 'Actief sinds 2023'). Only category B (car), automatic-only per rijloket/CBR. Very small school: only 7-11 CBR exams/yr, CBR pass rate ~11-14% (well below 's-Hertogenbosch avg ~45%). Strong English-language support evidenced by multiple expat reviews (English, plus one review citing instructor teaching in Dutch/English/Persian). Email alsleh.sosan@gmail.com. DATA-QUALITY CAUTION: aggregators mix content - clickdrive 'Over' text erroneously describes 'Autorijschool Baron'; rijloket lists website autorijschoolsam.com and a different phone (06 44625071) which appear to belong to another school (Autorijschool Sam, KvK 88495256, CBR 1960G1) - so no verified OWN website found for Rijschool Sosan. Core identifiers (KvK 88886654, CBR 3164H1, Ampthe rstraat 28 5223CV) (Ampere 28, 5223CV) are consistent across vindjerijschool.nl, oozo.nl and clickdrive.nl. Ratings: 4.9 (67) clickdrive / 5.0 (68) rijloket.
